summary: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce (CIBC) filed a Form 6-K attaching legal opinions and an underwriting agreement for a debt issuance. CIBC issued US$1 billion of 4.723% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2029 and US$1 billion of 5.051% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Senior Notes due 2032 under an existing shelf registration. The filing is a routine capital markets transaction, not a special situation. No terms beyond principal and coupon are stated. This is a standard equity/debt shelf takedown; no special-situations event is present.
